tryb.co: Choose how many questions you want to see.
tryb.poco: Basic is enough for most people. Advanced shows every option and extra devices. You can change the mode later in “Configure”.

mam.co: Tick what you have. The wizard searched Home Assistant and ticked what it found.
mam.poco:
The wizard shows only the steps and features for ticked devices. You can add the rest later in “Configure”.

Found: {znalezione}

urzadzenie.co: Choose the motor (a shade or a gate), give it a name and pick the room.
urzadzenie.poco: Motor HA controls this motor. Talk to Assist using the device name, e.g. “close Kitchen pleated blind”.

rodzaj.poco: The card draws this device, and the automation knows what it can use.

lamele.poco: You let light in without raising the blind.

kolory.co: Choose the colour of the shade and the frame.
kolory.poco: The window on screen looks like the real one.

okno.co: How many sashes the window has and how big it is on the card.
okno.poco: Each sash can have its own motor.

czujniki.co: Choose the window and door opening sensors.
czujniki.poco: The card shows a tilted or open sash, and the lock never lowers the shade onto an open window.

fotokomorka.co: Pick the gate obstacle sensor and the state that means “something is in the gate”.
fotokomorka.poco: The card shows the obstacle and you can get a notification. The photocell in the controller still stops the gate by itself.

silnik.co: Enter the full travel time or leave 0.
silnik.poco: The drawing moves as fast as the real motor. With 0 the card learns the time by itself after a few moves.

pogoda.co: Choose the weather and outdoor sensors.
pogoda.poco: Real weather shows behind the glass, and the automation protects the shade from wind, rain and sun.

domownicy.co: Choose presence, motion and household sensors.
domownicy.poco: The shade can react to whether someone is in the room or at home.

automatyka.co: Turn on the features that may move the shade by themselves.
automatyka.poco: Your home looks after the shades without writing automations. All are off until you turn them on.

ustawienia.co: Adjust the features you turned on.

powiadomienia.co: Choose what to tell you about.
powiadomienia.poco: You know right away which device has a problem. Notifications go to HA and, if you choose, to your phone.

panel.co: Which dashboard to add the card to.
panel.poco: The card appears by itself, nothing to click.

pola.name: Name
pola.foto_stan: Obstacle when the sensor state is
pola.kalibruj: Calibrate now (the shade goes up, down and up)
pola.na_panel: Add the card to a dashboard
pola.wstecz: Go back to the previous step

pomoc.rolety: For a window with two sashes choose two: first the left one, then the right one.
pomoc.name: Empty = the motor's name.
pomoc.pokoj: The device goes to this room, so it is easy to find.
pomoc.ukryj_zrodlo: Assist then sees only the Motor HA device, not the motor itself. Helps when Assist says there are several devices with this name. Off by default.
pomoc.odwroc: Turn on when the motor reports 100 % with the shade closed.
pomoc.czas: 0 = automatic: from the motor speed, calibration or real moves.
pomoc.foto_stan: Usually “on”. For a text sensor enter e.g. “obstructed”.
pomoc.czujnik_jasnosc: A lux meter or solar power – instead of the sun position alone.
pomoc.czujnik_swieta: Workday integration – holidays count as weekend.
pomoc.powiadom_gdzie: The HA app on your phone. Nothing chosen – notifications in HA only.
pomoc.wstecz: Turn on and click “Next” to go back one step. What you entered stays.

harmonogram: Opens in the morning and closes in the evening: at fixed times or with sunrise and sunset.
slonce: Lowers the shade when the sun shines into this window and it is warm.
blokada: Never lowers the shade onto an open or tilted window. A skipped move runs after the window closes.
wiatr: Retracts an outdoor shade in strong wind.
obecnosc: In the morning it stays closed until someone enters the room.
wakacje: Opens and closes at a slightly different time every day, as if someone were home.
licznik: Counts moves and run time, reminds you to calibrate.
reczny: When you move the shade with a remote or a button, the automation waits.
posrednia: At the chosen time the shade stops half way.
dni: Separate times at weekends and on holidays.
wietrzenie: With a tilted window the shade stays higher so air can flow.
drzwi: With the door open the shade goes no lower than the chosen position.
oslepianie: The shade goes down only so far that the sun reaches no further than the TV or desk.
zima: In winter it opens in the sun (free heat), in summer it shades.
jasnosc: A lux meter or solar panels decide about the sun.
temp_pokoj: Shades when the room gets too warm.
deszcz: Retracts the awning, screen and external venetian blind in the rain.
mroz: In frost the outdoor shade does not move, so it does not freeze.
grad: On a warning it retracts awnings and closes shutters to protect the glass.
drgania: Retracts the awning in a strong gust.
upal: When the forecast says heat, the shade goes down in the morning before the room warms up.
dym: On a smoke alarm it opens the shade – an escape route.
alarm: Closes the shade when the alarm is armed.
nikogo: Closes the shade when everyone leaves.
przeszkoda: Does not go down when the sensor sees something in the way.
spie: A switch on the device: the shade stays closed until you turn it off.
granice: The shade moves only within the chosen range, e.g. 10–90 %.
drobne: Skips changes of a few percent.
po_kolei: Shades in the house move a few seconds apart.
cisza: After HA starts the automation waits a few minutes.
proba: Shows what the automation would do, but does not move the shade.

azymut: Where the window faces: 90 east, 180 south, 270 west.
szer_slonca: How many degrees left and right of the window direction the sun shines in.
min_wys_slonca: Trees and houses hide a lower sun.
slonce_temp: Outdoors, from which the shade goes down in the sun.
harm_tryb: With sunrise and sunset or at fixed times.
przesuniecie: Minutes after sunrise and before sunset.
upal_prog: The highest temperature in the forecast.
jasnosc_prog: Lux or watts from solar panels.
wakacje_rozrzut: Plus or minus this many minutes, different every day.
drzwi_min: With the door open no lower than
obiekt_odl_m: How far from the window the TV or desk stands.

powiadomienia.bateria: Low battery in the motor or sensor

porady.ogolne_tryb: Not sure? Choose Basic. You can always change it.
porady.ogolne_mam: Not sure whether you have something? Leave it as the wizard ticked it.
porady.ogolne_kolory: The colour is only on screen, it changes nothing in the shade itself.
porady.ogolne_okno: Two sashes with one shutter? Choose “Two sashes” and one motor.
porady.ogolne_silnik: Leave 0 – the card measures the time by itself after a few moves.
porady.ogolne_pogoda: A weather entity is enough. An anemometer gives more precise protection.
porady.ogolne_automatyka: Start with one feature and see how it works. The “Reason” sensor shows why the shade moved.
porady.ogolne_lamele: An angle of 45° lets light in, while the sun does not shine straight into the room.
porady.ogolne_fotokomorka: No photocell in HA? The gate works the same, the card just does not know about the obstacle.
porady.sypialnia_rodzaj: A blackout blind or a day-night blind is best for a bedroom. Morning light does not wake you.
porady.sypialnia_automatyka: We recommend the schedule (sunrise in the morning, sunset in the evening) and the window lock if you sleep with the window tilted.
porady.sypialnia_czujniki: In a bedroom the window is often tilted at night. Set “Tilts”.
porady.salon_rodzaj: In a living room people usually choose day-night or pleated blinds – they let light in and block the view from the street.
porady.salon_automatyka: We recommend sun protection. With a presence sensor the shade opens when someone comes in in the morning.
porady.kuchnia_rodzaj: A cassette blind or an aluminium venetian blind suits a kitchen – easy to clean.
porady.kuchnia_automatyka: We recommend the open window lock – the window is often open while cooking.
porady.dziecko_rodzaj: A blackout blind is useful in a child's room for daytime naps.
porady.dziecko_automatyka: We recommend the night schedule and the window lock.
porady.gabinet_rodzaj: In an office a venetian blind or a screen reduces glare on the monitor.
porady.gabinet_automatyka: We recommend glare protection – the shade goes down only as far as needed.
porady.lazienka_rodzaj: For a bathroom choose a damp-proof shade: an aluminium venetian or a pleated blind.
porady.lazienka_automatyka: We recommend the window lock – the window is often open after a bath.

bledy.za_duzo: Choose at most two motors (left and right sash).

powody.czeka_obecnosc: Waiting for someone to come in

komunikaty.nie_odpowiada: {nazwa}: the motor is not responding ({encje}). Check power or range.
komunikaty.nie_dojechala: {nazwa}: should have reached {cel} %, but stands at {jest} %.
komunikaty.automatyka: {nazwa}: the automation did not move the shade – {powod}.
komunikaty.kalibracja: {nazwa}: the motor made {ruchy} moves since calibration. Press “Calibrate” on the device.
komunikaty.brama_otwarta: {nazwa}: the gate has been open for more than {minuty} min.
komunikaty.nie_motor_ha: This is not a Motor HA device.

wstrzymaj: The automation does not move the device for the given time (empty = until the end of the day).

minuty: Empty = until the end of the day.

wznow: Ends the pause and checks right away where the shade should be.
przelicz: The automation recalculates the position right away.
ustaw: Sets the position (and slats) like the automation – without a manual-move pause.

naprawa.o: The new version is installed. Click “Submit” to restart Home Assistant.

przeniesione.o: {ile} windows were moved from the previous version (Okno HA 1.x). They now work as new Motor HA devices with the same settings. The old entries are only disabled – you can delete them in Settings → Devices & services → Okno HA. Automation stays off until you turn it on in “Configure”.
